assignments.reason: The King (Melekh) is the royal channel through which divine sustenance flows. The Rebbe states: 'כל הפרנסה של ישראל צריכין לקבל על ידי המלך' and 'מעדני מלך' literally means 'delicacies of the King'. The King's essential nature is the royal dimension of sustenance — the same domain as parnasa and maadanei melekh. He IS the source-identity of the kingly delicacies.

assignments.node_id: שכל הפרנסה של ישראל צריכין לקבל
assignments.reason: This node describes the principle that all of Israel's livelihood must be received through the King. Its essential nature is the mechanism of parnasa — the divine-royal channeling of sustenance. It belongs to the same domain as parnasa and maadanei melekh: the royal provision of livelihood.

The essence of kingship (ikar ha-malkhut) is the royal authority itself — the same domain as the King and his kingly delicacies. The Rebbe ties malkhut directly to the King who channels parnasa: the tree in Daniel that provides sustenance IS the King. The essential nature of malkhut is the royal power that produces and channels divine bounty, the same identity as Package 1.

The honor and greatness of kingship is the expanded, manifest form of malkhut — the King in his gadlut after donning royal garments. Its essential nature is the same royal domain as Package 1: the splendor of the King who provides maadanei melekh. It is the kavod dimension of the same kingship that channels sustenance.

assignments.package_label: הִתְחַבְּרוּת אִמְרֵי שֶׁפֶר עִם הַמֶּלֶךְ וְחֲתֻנָּה
assignments.reason: Imrei Shefer (beautiful words — blessings and prayers) is the holy speech that unites with the King. Package 3 is defined precisely around this union: 'התחברות שמתחברין האמרי שפר עם המלך'. The Imrei Shefer IS one of the two partners in this sacred wedding. Its essential nature — holy speech that bonds with royalty — is the core identity of Package 3.

assignments.package_label: הִתְחַבְּרוּת אִמְרֵי שֶׁפֶר עִם הַמֶּלֶךְ וְחֲתֻנָּה
assignments.reason: The Atara (crown) is formed from the Imrei Shefer when they unite with the King — it is the product and emblem of the chatuna (wedding). The Rebbe ties it directly to the chatuna verse: 'בעטרה שעטרה לו אמו ביום חתנתו'. Chavah (already in Package 3 via additions) is the one who crowns. The crown's essential nature is the manifest result of the sacred union — the same domain as the wedding/hitchabrut of Package 3.

assignments.package_label: הִתְחַבְּרוּת אִמְרֵי שֶׁפֶר עִם הַמֶּלֶךְ וְחֲתֻנָּה
assignments.reason: Seeing the King in his crown is the perception of the completed chatuna — the King adorned with the atara formed from Imrei Shefer. The Rebbe states: 'צאינה וראינה... במלך שלמה בעטרה שעטרה לו אמו ביום חתנתו'. This vision is essentially the experiential culmination of the union described in Package 3. Its nature is the revealed glory of the sacred wedding — the same domain as the crown and chatuna.

unassigned_nodes.reason: Humility (anava) is the prerequisite that produces kingship — 'עקר המלכות הוא על ידי ענוה'. It is a distinct spiritual quality: self-diminishment, katnut, the smallness that precedes kavod. It does not share the essential nature of parnasa/royal sustenance (Package 1), clarification/incense (Package 2), or the speech-king union/wedding (Package 3). Anava is the cause that enables malkhut but is not itself malkhut. No existing package matches its essential nature.
